Compute ISR preempts RR ISR and overwrites RT4 before the threshold check.
Compute ISR preempts FL ISR and overwrites RT4 before FL reads it.

Compute ISR overwrites RT3 between FL ISR's write and its later read.
Compute ISR overwrites RT3 between FL ISR's write and its read in the else branch.
In JudgeCondi, called from the RR ISR, the compute ISR can change var1 between the two reads, so they see different values.
Compute ISR writes array[TRIGGER] between the FL ISR's write and its read, so the read sees 999 instead of 1.
